QuestInfo.name: Mastering Rock-Paper-Scissors
QuestInfo.0: Gaga is training Maplers in the art of Rock-Paper-Scissors. Pay him a visit.
QuestInfo.1: Gaga is training Maplers in the art of Rock-Paper-Scissors. Pay him a visit.
QuestInfo.2: You received a Score Card from Gaga. Ask him what the next step is.

0.0: Hello. Hm...you look like you have some potential. Do you think you have what it takes to be a Rock-Paper-Scissors Master? I'll help you train if you do.

yes.0: The thing is, everyone knows how to play Rock-Paper-Scissors, so a true Master must train hard to push past the normal limits of play. Here's a Score Card. Every day that you and I practice, mark it down on that card. And don't lose it.

no.0: Really? Rock-Paper-Scissors is easy to learn, but hard to master. You should give it a try.
